findingDetails.title: The hub README release index stops at 1.1.1.0 and omits the two newest releases, including the one that carries the phase 015 fixes
findingDetails.scopeProof: ls changelog/ lists five files and grep -n "changelog/v" README.md returns three rows at :70-72, so the gap is exactly two rows in one table; the three mode packets each carry a complete changelog set

results.summary: Carried from iteration 3. The README release index is not one of the seven goal criteria, so this finding does not change the criterion results.
Phase 015 names changelog/v1.1.3.0.md as the release that shipped its fixes, which is what makes the missing README row a real gap.

noveltyJustification: Weighted new = 1 (one P2). Weighted total = 1 new + 6 carried = 7. Ratio 1/7 = 0.1429. The finding is new: the README release index was not read in any prior iteration.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Maintainability reads the documentation set that describes the release; the README index and the changelog set are the two surfaces that must agree
omittedHighRiskTargets: the three mode README bodies (only their version pins were swept)
